purpose: Required Azure DevOps variables for the controlled Craves production deployment pipelines
rules: All secretVariables must be marked secret in Azure DevOps and must never be echoed.
CRAVES_INTERNAL_SERVICE_SECRET, CRAVES_INTERNAL_SERVICE_KEY and CRAVES_INTERNAL_SMOKE_SECRET must contain the same shared internal secret value.
FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID must match project_id inside FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON_BASE64.
CRAVES_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM_BASE64 and CRAVES_JWT_VERIFICATION_PEM_BASE64 must form one RSA keypair.
JDBC URLs must use jdbc:postgresql:// and must not embed passwords.
The pipeline validates values but performs no Azure mutation.
